title.zh: 从权限边界到可复查交付
title.en: From permission boundaries to reviewable delivery

summary.zh: 结合资料归档与辅导员系统，整理资源授权、流程状态和发布证据之间的联系。
summary.en: Connect resource authorization, workflow states and release evidence through the archive and counselor-system cases.

basis.zh: 依据公开工程案例和发布检查示例归纳。权限矩阵是后续验证提案，未运行原系统的权限集成测试或完整业务验收。
basis.en: Derived from published engineering cases and the release-check example. The permission matrix is a proposed verification plan; original-system authorization tests and full business acceptance were not run.

title.zh: 01 / 一个按钮隐藏后，资源仍然存在
title.en: 01 / Hiding a button does not remove a resource

paragraphs.zh: 资料系统容易把权限理解为菜单显示：教师看上传，管理员看审核。但复制链接、修改文件 ID、导出清单都可能绕过原页面。应先问“这个人能对这个资源做什么”，再决定页面如何提示。权限必须覆盖读取、下载与导出等入口。
paragraphs.en: An archive interface can reduce permissions to menu visibility: teachers see upload, administrators see review. Yet copied links, altered file IDs and exports bypass the original page. Start with what this actor may do to this resource, then decide how to present it. Authorization must cover reading, downloading and exporting.

title.zh: 02 / 角色、归属和状态需要一起判断
title.en: 02 / Evaluate role, ownership and state together

paragraphs.zh: 归档案例记录了教师仅看本人文件、管理角色查询所属学院，以及列表、CSV 和打印清单复用查询范围。版本表达内容演进，审核表达材料是否合格。辅导员系统又区分本人、班级、学院及关怀正文可见范围；这些资源不能套用一个“已登录即可访问”的判断。
paragraphs.en: The archive case records teacher access to personal files, administrative queries scoped to the actor's college, and a shared query scope for lists, CSV and print manifests. Versions describe content evolution; review states describe acceptability. The counselor system further separates personal, class, college and student-care visibility. A single signed-in check cannot express these boundaries.

paragraphs.zh: 进度 100% 也不能代替验收通过。前端可以提示下一步，后端仍需核对角色、归属与当前流程状态，防止旧页面提交过期动作。
paragraphs.en: Progress at 100% also does not replace approval. The frontend may explain the next action, but the backend still checks role, ownership and current workflow state so an old page cannot submit a stale action.

title.zh: 03 / 把权限规则变成反例矩阵
title.en: 03 / Turn permission rules into a counterexample matrix

paragraphs.zh: 下面是基于归档规则提出的最小测试矩阵，并非现有测试结果。为每一行同时检查列表、详情、下载和清单导出，另测未登录和会话过期。直接请求接口很重要：从页面看不到记录，不能证明后端拒绝访问。
paragraphs.en: The matrix below is a minimal proposal derived from the archive rules, not an existing test result. For each row, check lists, details, downloads and exports, then add signed-out and expired-session cases. Direct API requests matter: a record being absent from the page does not prove the backend rejects access.

code.text:
Proposed archive checks; synthetic actors/resources
Actor             Resource                    Expected
Teacher A         own file / college X        allow read
Teacher A         Teacher B file / college X  deny read
Administrator X   file / college X            allow scoped read
Administrator X   file / college Y            deny read
Teacher A         own pending file            deny review

Repeat each applicable read check across:
list -> detail -> download -> export

callout.zh: 矩阵用于发现跨入口不一致；更细的审核状态、删除状态和字段可见性仍需继续展开。
callout.en: The matrix targets inconsistent decisions across entry points. Review states, deletion states and field-level visibility require further cases.

title.zh: 04 / 共享规则能减少偏差，也会集中风险
title.en: 04 / Shared rules reduce drift but concentrate risk

paragraphs.zh: 复用查询范围能减少导出接口漏加学院条件，但公共函数写错时影响也更广。较稳妥的组合是集中表达策略、在接口边界执行检查，并用跨角色反例覆盖调用点。附件访问还要关联所属资源，不能仅凭文件名或下载链接判断。
paragraphs.en: Reusing query scope reduces the chance that an export omits a college restriction, but a defect in the shared function also spreads further. A useful combination is centralized policy, enforcement at API boundaries and cross-role counterexamples at callers. Attachment access must resolve its parent resource rather than trust a filename or download link.

paragraphs.zh: 归档中的数据库事务不包含磁盘写入。既有代码在元数据插入失败时清理文件，仍需考虑进程中断和残留文件回收。逻辑删除及操作日志提供追溯基础，但不自动提供防篡改审计。
paragraphs.en: Archive database transactions do not include disk writes. The reviewed implementation removes a newly written file when metadata insertion fails, while process interruption and orphan cleanup remain concerns. Logical deletion and operation logs provide a basis for tracing actions without automatically providing tamper-resistant auditing.

title.zh: 05 / 通过验收的版本，才能成为交付证据
title.en: 05 / Tie acceptance evidence to the delivered version

paragraphs.zh: 辅导员发布案例把后端、生产网页和浏览器报告的 SHA-256 绑定到验收摘要。打包前重算，复制后再比对。公开纯函数示例会拒绝产物变化、浏览器跳过、重启未完成或格式错误等摘要。阅读时应区分“规则判定示例”和“完整部署验证”。
paragraphs.en: The counselor release case binds SHA-256 digests of the backend, production frontend and browser report to an acceptance summary. Digests are recalculated before packaging and checked after copying. The public pure-function example rejects changed artifacts, skipped browser checks, incomplete restart evidence and malformed summaries. Its rule evaluation should be distinguished from complete deployment validation.

code.text:
Acceptance: backend=A, frontend=B, browser-report=C
Before packaging: backend=A, frontend=D, browser-report=C
Decision: reject; frontend changed after acceptance
Next step: inspect the change, rebuild and repeat relevant checks

callout.zh: 相同哈希支持文件一致性判断，不证明报告真实，也不授予发布权限。
callout.en: Matching hashes support artifact consistency; they do not prove report authenticity or grant permission to release.

title.en: 06 / Make the next step independently reviewable

paragraphs.zh: 既有辅导员记录包含 17 项浏览器与 18 项打包保护检查，本次未重跑。归档版本递增仍需并发验证，真实部署和名单迁移也不在这些结论内。后续应公开合成角色夹具、失败断言和产物清单，让读者能复查一个小而完整的边界，再讨论效率或可靠性提升。
paragraphs.en: Historical counselor records include 17 browser checks and 18 packaging-protection checks; they were not rerun for this note. Concurrent archive version increments, production deployment and real roster migration remain outside those conclusions. Publishing synthetic role fixtures, failure assertions and artifact manifests would let a reader inspect a small but complete boundary before discussing improvements in efficiency or reliability.
